summary_zh: Floci 是免费开源的本机 AWS 模拟器，可在无需云账号、认证令牌或付费功能门槛的情况下，在本机提供 AWS 形态的服务。让 AWS SDK、CLI、Terraform、CDK、OpenTofu 或测试套件指向 http://localhost:4566，即沿用原有工作流；也可作为 LocalStack 的替代品。
audience_zh: 适合需要本地开发、测试和 CI 中使用 AWS 服务的开发者与测试人员，包括使用 AWS SDK、CLI、Terraform、CDK、OpenTofu 或测试套件的人群，以及正在使用 LocalStack 并寻求替代方案的用户。

evidence.quote: Floci is a free, open-source local AWS emulator for development, testing, and CI.

It gives you AWS-shaped services on your machine without requiring a cloud account, an auth token, or paid feature gates. Point your AWS SDK, CLI, Terraform, CDK, OpenTofu, or test suite at `http://localhost:4566` and keep your existing workflows.
No account. No auth token. No feature gates. Just docker compose up.
Already using LocalStack? Floci is a drop-in replacement: swap the image and keep going. See [Migrating from LocalStack](#migrating-from-localstack).
